newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka surrenders early gains, ends lower.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka surrenders early gains, ends lower.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka surrendered early gains to close easier at 42.5375/42.5450 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5300/42.5450, dealers said.

The taka had been quoted at 42.52/42.54 against the dollar in early trade but dealers said the early gains petered out as the demand for dollars from importers picked up. The volume of trade was around $20 million, they said.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.5 percent to 5.0 percent against the previous 4.0-5.0 percent.
